scope.goal: Repair timeout registry/supervisor compatibility and document truthful post-init readiness.
files: focused adjacent tests resolved by graph and tracked-file inventory
constraints: all timeouts remain finite and positive
do not promote advisory checks to enforced in this patch
do not mask performance problems by unbounded timeout increases
installation guidance must not claim action readiness before effective rules exist

architecture_decisions: enforcement class and timeout budget remain independent
user_constraints: no push, PR, merge, terminal provider mutation, tag, Release, or publication

authorization_source: User instruction in the dedicated 0.15.1 conversation

acceptance_criteria: registry rejects zero, negative, NaN, and infinite timeouts
all current registrations use positive budgets without enforcement-class drift
INSTALL explains action_ready false and effective-rule-state-missing with the next governance action

steps: inventory registry parsing and adjacent tests
select evidence-based positive budgets for the three affected checks
add fail-closed registry validation and focused fixtures
update INSTALL readiness guidance and run focused validation
execution.commit_checkpoint: one coherent workflow commit after validation and review evidence are complete

results.summary: Assigned finite 60-second budgets to the three deferred advisory checks, made registry metadata reject every non-positive or non-integer timeout, and documented the unresolved effective-rule readiness handoff without changing enforcement or public CLI behavior.

test_execution.summary: 9 passed in 1.467s outside the sandbox after the initial Git Bash attempt failed to create its signal pipe.
102 post-adoption workflows, 122 indexed workflow directories, and 0 backlog items.

validation_evidence: all current registry timeouts matched ^[1-9][0-9]*$ under the focused registry test
the three affected check IDs retained advisory enforcement, nightly-full membership, and deferred disposition
INSTALL guidance routes effective-rule-state-missing to ai-context-init or ai-context-upgrader and revalidation
